title: Law to require bike and scooter share apps to show safety rules
summary: This bill would require operators of shared bike and scooter systems to display traffic safety rules to users through their apps and at physical docking stations. Users would have to review the rules at least once a year before unlocking a device, with no fee charged for that time, and stations must display the rules within one year of the law taking effect. The rules must cover topics like yielding to pedestrians, obeying traffic signals, riding direction, sidewalk use, bell use, headphone use and safe speeds.
